tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled in all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. This is consistent with the recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It has one paragraph saying TLS certificate verification is on in all builds, development builds included, with no build type exempt. It also notes this fits the recorded "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions" decision.

The main source is the recorded decision "verification on all builds" (#21). It replaced an earlier record (#19) that allowed disabling verification in dev builds, so I left that older position out. #24, "https everywhere, no exceptions", is consistent with it.

One earlier session note, #22, said internal hosts would use plain HTTP. It is only a session excerpt, not a recorded decision, and #24 now says no exceptions. I didn't include it.
